slides.text: Common advice: make a habit take *2 minutes*.
That helps you *start*. It ignores what comes next.
*Missing half 2:* Attach it to something you *already do*.
*Small and anchored* beats big and heroic.
Pick one habit and shrink it today.
slides.sub: Follow for one small rule daily

caption:
Starting small is only half the system. Add an endpoint and an anchor.

What habit are you shrinking this week?
